cue: A test is run by hand and only its result is written down.
lesson: Keep the test as a file the next agent or machine can run; the event names the file.
evidence: AIP-2 c4's test (planted failure, planted hang, no setup file) existed only as an event at 09:58; AIP-2's thread had to write it again as theOS/sandbox/test.sh to run it a second time.
